_twist: Comic/Pop-Art nav: yellow #ffeb3b background, 3px bottom border solid black, Bangers font for all links, offset shadow on logo, speech-bubble active indicator above active link.

activeState.note: Active nav link has a small CSS speech bubble triangle indicator above it, in comic-red

scrollTransition.note: Nav stays yellow on scroll — comic pages don't change panels mid-read

characterDescription: A bold yellow nav bar that feels like the top panel of a comic page — loud, declarative, and fun. Bangers font throughout. 3px black bottom border creates the panel divider feel. Logo has a red offset shadow. Active links show a speech-bubble indicator above them.
